prose: Can the mind really heal the body? In this episode of the InnerVerse Podcast, we sit down with Brandy Gillmore, who spent seven years in a wheelchair due to "incurable" chronic pain before discovering the missing link in her recovery.

Tune in for Brandy’s journey from network engineering to mind-body healing, exploring the specific subconscious ingredients, like hidden survivors' guilt, that can trap the body in a state of illness even when you’re doing everything else right.
